title: Share of US adults who have ever taken a GLP-1 drug (%)

source.name: KFF Health Tracking Poll on GLP-1 drugs

notes: The 2024 (12%) and 2025 (18%) points are the exact figures from KFF's May 2024 and 2025 Health Tracking Polls. Earlier years are an approximate reconstruction of the adoption curve before GLP-1 polling began, anchored to those two measured points.
